title: GitDock
description: An integrated Git workflow for VS Code: Commit tool window, Log with graph, Push and Conflicts dialogs, Shelf, changelists and familiar IDE shortcuts.

title: Leak Hunter — C memory leaks
description: Finds the memory leaks of any C program (leaks on macOS, Valgrind on Linux, Dr. Memory on Windows, clang or GCC static analysis) and shows the file, function and line of each one.

title: CSProj Auto Include
description: Automatically update explicit .csproj file includes when creating, moving, renaming, or deleting files in VS Code.

title: Mitts Build
description: Build, check, test and lint Rust projects with Mitts, a Cargo-compatible build tool with a shared artifact cache.

title: Velvet Ribbon
description: An all-pink VS Code theme with a rosewater editor, pink terminal, and high-contrast syntax.

title: Grey Lines for VS Code
description: Grey Lines: a near-black high-contrast color theme with crisp medium grey accents.
